item.title: Dodgers Sign Max Muncy To One-Year Contract Extension
item.description: The Los Angeles Dodgers agreed to terms with Max Muncy on a one-year contract extension for $10 million guaranteed, which includes a $7 million salary for the 2027 season and a $10 million club option for 2028. item.title: Dodgers Transfer Evan Phillips To 60-Day Injured List

item.title: Dodgers Re-Sign Kiké Hernández To One-Year Contract
